note: Last Node Standing on the Koinos TESTNET (Koinos Foundation testnet). Picks go to the testnet Picks contract named in testnet/blockx.json (the same contract as Who Signs Block X), with test KOIN only. The race itself is run on the real MAINNET producers, read only: the testnet has a single block producer, so it can not hold a race. Nothing here sends anything to mainnet. Games 94 (fast test) and 33 (real timing) use the one-pick rules of 2026-10-29: a start node and an optional backup, made before the start. Games 93 and 13 registered earlier on the testnet use the old hourly-pick rules and are no longer used.
